I need to look at your training to understand what you're doing. You haven't logged any workouts yet, so I can't see what those intervals are or what your plan is built around. Heart rate zones are personal — they're based on your max heart rate, your fitness level, and what stimulus you're after. At 170, you're working hard, which is useful for some goals and some training phases. But whether it's right for *your* fat loss depends on what your program is asking for and how your body responds to it, not what a number says.

What program are you running, or are you training on your own right now?
